      "title": "A seat usually runs 'metasystem work build' from inside its goal worktree. When it does, the new design check appends its warning line to that worktree's git-tracked narrator digest (metasystem/records/narrator-digest.log) before the builder starts. The unit runner then records the builder's change as the whole worktree diff against the base commit, so every first build of a tier-2 or tier-3 unit that draws a warning carries an edit to a shared control file that the builder did not make. A warning is drawn when the goal has no accepted design, when its critique line is missing (which, by the design's own count, is true of all 11 designs accepted before this gate), when the critique is still open, or when the check cannot run. That edit goes into the unit's reviewed and proven diff and into the unit commit, and from there to main. In short, the change ships wrong behaviour into every gated build's subject. The gate itself works without a fix, but it is not safe: it silently changes what other work is judged on."
